minutes.headline: Planning Board voted to ask the ZBA to make the Stone Farm gas station permit conditional on the design bylaw.
minutes.summary: The board approved three sets of prior minutes, extended the Highfield Village deadline to November 24, and approved the findings and directives for 1259 Mass Ave. It then voted to send a polite letter to the ZBA asking that any special permit for the Stone Farm gas station be conditioned on the design bylaw and the board's development plan review directives. It also set an October 6 workshop with Sam and agreed to put extending the design bylaw to other districts on the September 22 agenda.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to ask the Zoning Board of Appeals to condition any special permit for the Stone Farm gas station on the design bylaw and the board's review directives.
The board approved the findings and directives for 1259 Mass Ave, contingent on final plan review.
The board extended the Highfield Village deadline to November 24 as requested, and staff will check why only part of the plan set is on the website.
A master plan workshop was set for October 6, 2014.
Extending the design bylaw to other commercial districts was put on the September 22 agenda.

why_it_matters: The Stone Farm letter is a request to the ZBA, which decides the special permit, and it bears on what design standards a new gas station would have to meet.
Extending the design bylaw to other districts could change the rules for future commercial building elsewhere in town, and that would first need a Town Meeting vote.
watch_next: September 22 Planning Board agenda: whether extending the design bylaw to other districts is taken up.
November 24: the extended Highfield Village deadline.
